Galaxy Watch9

Galaxy Watch9 is your personal health companion on the journey to better wellness. The new Galaxy Watch transforms daily routines into meaningful insights on sleep, activity, recovery and overall health. It adapts to your lifestyle in real time, offering personalised guidance backed by a long-lasting 390 mAh battery and the advanced Snapdragon® Wear Elite Platform. Start small and build healthier habits that last — with Galaxy Watch9 understanding you better over time.

HIGHLIGHTS

  • Catches unusual vital signals before you feel it

    Vitals on Galaxy Watch9 catches subtle changes in your body by tracking heart rate, heart rate variability, respiratory rate, skin temperature and blood oxygen during sleep. Monitor the signals to stay aware of your current status.

  • Tomorrow is built tonight

    Sleep tracking on Galaxy Watch9 monitors your sleep from bedtime to wake-up. Receive personalised insights into your rest to know your sleep patterns, habits and duration for better sleep management.

  • A program built around
    your stride

    Galaxy Watch9 supports smarter workouts by learning from your body and health data. Train with guidance on when to push and when to recover, helping you improve without overtraining.

  • Raise. Talk. Done

    Voice command on Galaxy Watch9 is easily accessible — just raise your wrist. With Google Gemini built in, you can get answers, organise tasks and access key information across apps exactly when you need it. , ,

  • Health doesn’t sleep.
    Neither does your Watch

    A larger battery with long-lasting power keeps Galaxy Watch9 going, whatever your day brings. Push past your usual mile on a run as Galaxy Watch9 tracks your exercise. Get more sleep with your rest monitored all through the night.

DESIGN

Light on the wrist. Heavy on detail

Galaxy Watch9 stands out with the signature cushion design while feeling light and right on your wrist.

Galaxy Watch9 in Cream with a Sport Band in Cream worn on a person's wrist angled slightly to the right, showcasing the slim and smooth look of the watch with the signature cushion design, as well as the thin and flexible Sport Band for a snug, comfortable fit throughout the day with minimal gap thanks to the Dynamic Lug System.

The Dynamic Lug System and airy, flexible Sport Band bring Galaxy Watch9 closer to your wrist, minimising gaps and keeping sensors in place for reliable health insights. Just wear it, forget it’s there and take on the day.

    HEALTH

    Health.
    Made easier

    Tomorrow is built tonight

    The quality of your sleep shapes your tomorrow. Galaxy Watch9 monitors your sleep from bedtime to wake-up, delivering personalised insights into your rest and its impact on daily performance. Understand your sleep patterns, habits and duration for better sleep management. Just wear Galaxy Watch9 to bed and experience more relaxing nights and more refreshing mornings.

    • ENERGY SCORE

      Push or pause?
      Energy score tells you

      Plan your day even before getting out of bed. Check your Energy Score for a clear view of your daily readiness, shaped by your latest sleep and activity trends. Look into the insights put together by Galaxy AI to make smarter decisions. Based on your score, choose between a morning run or a calming yoga session. Make better choices for your body — and set the tone for a more energetic day.

    • SLEEP COACHING

      Practice makes great mornings

      Reach your sleep goals with personalised Sleep Coaching designed around your sleep habits and routines. Wear Galaxy Watch9 during sleep for 1 week to create the baseline, then begin a 3-4 week coaching program. By learning your sleep patterns over time, Sleep Coaching offers tailored guidance to improve your rest. Build healthier bedtime habits and wake up more refreshed, day after day.

    • SLEEP APNEA

      FDA-approved sleep apnea risk detection

      Waking up tired even after a full night's sleep is a sign to pay attention to. Galaxy Watch9 detects signs of moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea risk by monitoring your blood oxygen levels throughout the night. Stop guessing why you're tired and uncover what's happening during your sleep.

      A program built around your stride

      After a restful night, you're ready to step into your stride and take on the day — starting with a steady morning run or easing into movement that suits your energy. A personal coach on your wrist makes every workout smarter and more effective. Galaxy Watch9 learns from your body and health data to guide your training — when to push harder and when to recover — helping you improve without overtraining. From intense runs to recovery days, Galaxy Watch9 is with you every step of the way.

      • FITNESS INDEX

        Know your fitness level.
        Own your progress

        Start your next-level fitness journey with Fitness Index. Galaxy Watch9 gives you a clear, comprehensive overview of your performance based on your VO2Max, BIA, heart rate, steps and activity data. Get tailored content on your goals and physical capability to make steady progress on your fitness journey.

      • RUNNING COACH

        Personal training,
        on the run

        Ready to see how far you can really go? Set your goals and start training with a 3–5 week Running Coach program that adapts to your ability, whether you’re a first-time runner or a marathon trainee. Each guided session helps you train at a personalised pace to develop endurance, gain confidence and keep pushing past your limits.

      • DAILY CARDIO LOAD

        Train. Recover. Track both

        Get simple guidance on your body's readiness. Galaxy Watch9 estimates your Daily Cardio Load by analysing recent changes in your physical strain. Based on the score, take a day to recover or go the extra mile with confidence. Set higher goals with the intuitive Daily Cardio Load.

          A complete picture of your heart health on your wrist

          • BP

Get personalised guidance and turn those insights into better habits.
